reason: Nothing new to comply with: no form, fee or deadline, and the serious, deliberate and sustained threshold is untouched. For a minor party the graver risk is disqualification by an administrative body or an uncertain lower forum; naming the High Court, as ss 7.6 and 8.10 already do, closes that door and gives the s 12 NZBORA right to stand a full-hearing forum. Defence costs are real but disqualification is rare and consequential; one named forum avoids satellite disputes.
